cause: Test gyms are made on the live server and recognised by their name, so a real gym with a 'QA' name can be deleted and old-brand test gyms are visible.
guard: Mark test gyms with a flag at creation and delete only flagged ones; keep test data off the live server.

cause: A failed read or call is drawn as an ordinary state (empty, not found, offline, switched off, nothing to do) because screens have no shared loading/failed/empty helper that keeps failure separate.
guard: One shared load-state helper with a distinct 'could not load, try again' state, plus a check that every data read on a screen handles the failed state.

cause: Each screen writes its own 'contact MettleUp / tell your gym' line, often with no number, link or fallback, because there is no shared support-contact component.
guard: One shared Get help / contact MettleUp component used on every error, dead end and support line, with a check that bans bare 'message MettleUp' text.

cause: Deleting a gym, a member leaving and Erase each list by hand what to remove, so new stores are missed, some are kept too long and proof that must stay is deleted.
guard: One retention table (what is deleted, kept or emptied, and when) that every delete path reads, with a test that a deleted gym, leaver and erase leave nothing outside the table.

cause: The same number (active members, ending this week, kg lifted, week goal, batch count) is counted separately on each screen, file and summary, so the same words show different numbers.
guard: One shared metric module that every screen, export and summary reads, with a test that the same input gives the same figure everywhere it is labelled the same.

cause: One fixed message is used for several real situations (saved vs handed over, PIN vs code, preview vs saved, which folder), because the screen does not pick its words from the actual result.
guard: Messages after an action are chosen from the action's real result object, with a test per result branch.

cause: The privacy notice and on-screen data promises are typed by hand instead of being built from the list of what is actually sent, stored or shared, so they understate what leaves the phone.
guard: Keep one list of every data field sent off the device and who sees it, and a check that the privacy notice and each 'stays on this phone / only the gym sees' line agree with it.

cause: Help questions, team replies, alert sign-ups, quick buttons and the shop key are kept per browser or phone instead of per gym and person, so they leak to the next user or are lost on another device.
guard: A rule that person or gym data is stored server-side under gym + person, with a check that flags localStorage use for anything but per-device conveniences.

cause: Backups, exports and cloud copies each list by hand which kinds of data they include, so new tables, files, columns and photos are left out.
guard: Build each copy's scope from the schema and storage list, and a test that fails when a table, column or file store is in no copy.

cause: Events that need someone to act (a booking change, a payment decision, an unanswered question, a waiting join, a stopped copy) have no alert, because alerts are added by hand per event with no list of who must know.
guard: One table of events and who must be told, checked by a test that each event in the table sends its alert.

cause: Work that MettleUp must do by hand (credit top-ups, complaints, refunds, page reports, lock-outs, delete requests) arrives through general boxes with no queue, kind or tool in HQ.
guard: Every hand-work request is a marked kind with its own HQ queue and Needs you count, and no screen may promise MettleUp action without that queue.

cause: The gym's MettleUp plan state (waiting payment, plan switch, end reminder, open pay links) is decided in several places tied to online checkout, so UPI-paying gyms are treated wrongly.
guard: One billing state machine on the server that all reminders and plan changes read, with tests for UPI, waiting and switch cases.

cause: Emergency access to a gym's records was built without matching the owner-facing promise or telling the owner, so the words promise consent that the button does not need.
guard: One rule for emergency access (words, consent and an owner notice each time it opens) with a test that opening it writes the owner notice.

cause: Disconnecting the shop does not close it on the server.
guard: Close the shop server-side on disconnect, with a test that blocks new orders.

cause: Import reads a plan's length from the first number in its name.
guard: Parse length only from length words, with a fixture set of real plan names.

cause: Pass visits do not store the pass company at check-in, so history is read from the member's current pass.
guard: Write the company on the visit row, with a test that edits the member afterwards.

cause: Small controls and tappable rows are drawn as plain text with no shared tap-row or text-button style, so they do not look tappable.
guard: Shared tap-row and quiet-button components (arrow, underline or outline) and a design check that every pressable element uses one.

cause: The service rests on one person's accounts, domains and single-copy keys with no written way back, so losing one account or key breaks the service.
guard: A written, checked register of every account, domain and key with a second holder, a copy and replace steps, reviewed before launch.

cause: Hinglish covers only the screens whose words were wrapped in the language lookup, and nothing fails when a new line is left unwrapped or a Hinglish line is wrong.
guard: A check that fails on any user-facing string not passed through the language lookup, plus a read-aloud review of new Hinglish lines.

cause: Icon buttons, card buttons, boxes and rows get no spoken name, or one that differs from what is shown, because components do not build the spoken name from their visible words and state.
guard: Shared components that derive the spoken name and state from visible text, and an accessibility check that flags unnamed or mismatched controls.

cause: Help articles are written by hand apart from the screens and the help check covers only some folders, so help lags, contradicts or skips live features.
guard: The help check walks every screen, sheet and component folder and fails when a live feature has no help answer or an answer names a removed or changed part.

cause: Screens and messages name menus, tabs and buttons by hand ('in Profile', 'tap Back up now'), so the words go stale when a screen or button moves or changes.
guard: Name places through one shared table of menu paths and button labels, and a check that fails when text names a label that no longer exists.

cause: Controls are sized one by one, so many fall under the 44/48-point finger size the apps already set as a rule.
guard: Enforce the minimum touch size in the shared button components and add a measured tap-size check to the render and accessibility gates.

cause: Nightly jobs, keys, outside services and devices can stop working with only a hidden log line, because nothing records each part's last good run where HQ's health check reads it.
guard: Each job, key and outside dependency writes a last-good-run record that HQ's health page reads, with an alert when a record is older than its window.

cause: Failures the apps catch themselves (saves, imports, sign-in, native alerts, watch crashes) are shown calmly but never reach MettleUp, because the crash report path is used only for uncaught crashes.
guard: Every caught failure on a key task calls one shared report helper (no personal data, rate-limited), checked by a test that fails when a catch on a key task does not report.

cause: Shown notifications and pop-ups have no 'close when the thing is done or changed' step, so stale notices stay or keep coming after the job, renewal, switch-off or erase.
guard: Every alert kind declares the event that clears it, and a test checks each clear event removes the notice on phone, browser and watch.

cause: Each alert sets its own sound, vibration, channel importance and watch buzz, so OEM silencing, silent mode and the watch are handled for some alerts and not others.
guard: One shared alert helper that applies channel importance, silent-mode, rescue ring and watch buzz to every alert, tested on an OEM phone and a paired watch.

cause: A save or action that fails is caught and dropped with no word to the person, because each screen handles its own errors instead of going through one shared save helper that shows the failure.
guard: Route every user-started save through the shared save helper that always shows a calm failure line, and a lint rule that bans empty catch blocks on user actions.

cause: The list of live features and the 'not live' notes are kept by hand, so removed, hidden or now-live features are still listed wrongly and their help and leftover code linger.
guard: Derive the feature register's live/hidden/removed status from the actual feature switches and fail a check when a listed live feature has no reachable screen.

cause: Words about how people pay (at the desk or online, UPI or company) are fixed text on each screen instead of being read from the gym's one payment setting, so they go wrong when online paying is on.
guard: One shared 'how this gym takes payment' helper that every pay sentence, help line and alert reads, with a test for each switch combination.

cause: Results, errors and new answers appear without being read out (or are read out again every minute), because there is no shared announce line.
guard: One shared live-message helper that announces changes once, used by every result and error line.

cause: 'Not now', 'Skip' and close on cards and offers hide them for good without saying where to find them again.
guard: A rule that every dismiss either comes back or says where the thing lives, applied in the shared card component.

cause: Form errors, limits and reasons are shown in a top banner, a placeholder, a stale warning or not at all, instead of at the field, because forms have no shared field-error pattern.
guard: Shared field components that show the reason at the box, scroll to the first problem and clear stale warnings, used by every form sheet.

cause: The release checks prove only one path (last release, stock emulator, GitHub copy, phone without watch, one deploy order), so other real update and release paths ship unproven.
guard: A release-path matrix (older release, Play copy, watch, paired watch, OEM phone, deploy order, version bumps) that the release run must pass.

cause: Closing a sheet, panel or form, or a rewrite, throws away what was typed or spoken, because sheets have no shared keep-the-draft or ask-before-closing rule.
guard: A shared sheet behaviour that keeps drafts and asks before throwing away changes, tested by closing each sheet mid-entry.

cause: Hand-made pick-one lists, toggles and folds lack the proper roles, open/closed state and arrow keys, because there is no shared choice component.
guard: Shared radio-group, toggle and fold components with roles, states and arrow keys, checked by the accessibility crawl.

cause: Internal names (database step numbers, 'old owner key', 'gym server', system prefixes, the old brand kind) reach people, because raw stored values and code words go straight into text with no plain-words layer.
guard: A words check that fails on a list of internal terms in any user text, and a rule that stored codes are mapped to plain words before display.

cause: Charts, calendars, picked swatches, best sets and chat senders carry meaning only by colour, bar height, hover or touch, with no words or shape.
guard: A rule that every visual-only meaning has a text or shape twin and a spoken summary, checked in the accessibility review.

cause: There is no one rule that decides when a pop-up may ring (quiet hours, urgent kinds, the daily allowance, grouping edits), so each sender rings at any hour and in any amount.
guard: One shared send policy (quiet hours, urgency, allowance, batching) that every member and gym alert goes through, with tests for night, urgent and over-allowance cases.

cause: The open admin app and HQ ring and pop up through their own in-page code, which skips the alert settings, the device switch and the browser's delivery limits.
guard: Route in-page rings through the same alert settings check as background alerts, with a test that each setting silences the open-tab path.

cause: Sheets, panels and page changes do not move or hold keyboard focus, because each opens and closes itself without a shared focus-trap helper.
guard: Shared sheet and page components that move focus in, hold it and return it, with a keyboard check in the accessibility crawl.

cause: Dates and times use whatever clock is to hand (device clock, UTC, a 05:30 reset), because there is no shared India-day and server-time helper.
guard: One shared time helper (server time, India day) used for every cut-off, label and export, with tests at midnight IST and with the device clock moved.

cause: Counts are glued to a fixed plural word ('1 days', '1 members'), because there is no shared plural helper.
guard: One shared count-and-noun helper used for every count, plus a test of the 1 and 0 cases.

cause: Who may see or do what (desk vs owner, branch access, pause rules) is decided screen by screen instead of from one permission rule.
guard: One shared permission check that screens and words read, with a test per role on each guarded action.

cause: Custom boxes and buttons wipe or recolour the keyboard focus ring instead of using one shared focus style.
guard: One shared focus-ring style and a lint rule that bans removing outlines without it.

cause: Phone, watch, older phones and the server talk without telling each other their versions, so a newer or older side silently loses data, buttons or the reason for a refusal.
guard: A version handshake on every phone-watch-server message, with answers for unknown requests and a test with mixed versions.

cause: Text is sized in fixed pixels or with a fake scaling test, so it ignores the person's bigger text setting.
guard: Size text from the system or browser base size, and test with the real text scaling.

cause: Colour tokens are picked without a contrast check, so some words and badges are too faint in light or dark look.
guard: A contrast check on every colour token pair in both looks.

cause: The demo gym re-implements real gym rules in its own fake layer, so its counts, limits and approvals drift from the real gym.
guard: Run the demo through the real rule functions, with a test that demo and real give the same result for the same action.

cause: Number boxes set their own limits, so some silently drop a too-big number and others accept impossible values.
guard: One shared number field with declared limits that refuses and explains out-of-range values.

cause: Leads from the member app are sent once, thinly and unlabelled, because the lead path was built without retry, detail or a source label.
guard: One lead record with source, contact and retry, shown in HQ's daily work.

cause: Database change files are not safe to run again and the live state is not checked against them, so re-running an old step undoes later ones.
guard: A cloud check that runs every step twice in order and compares live functions with the newest file after each change.

cause: An admin or HQ tab left open keeps running the old version, because the page never checks for a new version.
guard: The open page checks the live version on its minute tick and shows a Reload line, with a test against a bumped version.

cause: Swapping the before and after photos skips the older-first rule, so the newer photo can be called Before.
guard: Keep the pair in time order after any swap, with a test.

cause: PIN set, change and sign-in each carry their own rules and words, so a saved PIN can be followed by a wrong error and a change lock does not grow.
guard: One PIN rule module (lock growth, current-PIN ask, saved-then-sign-in) used by every PIN path, with tests.

cause: Lists and searches stop at a fixed cap without saying so, because the cap is set per query with no shared 'and N more' pattern.
guard: Every capped list returns its true total and shows an 'and N more' line, checked by a test that a capped result carries its total.

cause: Refreshes are throttled by a time window alone, so a real change (a pop-up tap, new workout days) waits out or is thrown away by the window.
guard: Throttles skip only when the content is unchanged, and a push tap always forces a fresh read; tested with a change inside the window.

cause: Undo bars and saved notes vanish on a fixed short timer, and one is hand-made, so screen reader users and slow readers miss them.
guard: Use the shared undo/notice bar everywhere, with a longer or no timeout while a screen reader is on.

cause: A workout's name is worked out separately on each screen and copy (History, trainer, Health Connect, gym plan), so renames do not travel.
guard: One naming function and a rename that updates every copy, tested on each screen.

cause: Some records can only be added, never edited or closed (a staff job name, a branch).
guard: A rule that every added record kind gets edit and close paths, checked in design review.

cause: Giving AI credits back is not tied to the task's real status, so a failed give-back leaves a task stuck and a worked task can still be refunded.
guard: One credit-task state machine (waiting, done, failed, refunded) on the server, with tests for each move.

cause: The backup's own safety (one consistent moment, a separate place) is assumed rather than built and checked.
guard: Back up from a single read-only snapshot into a second, separate account, with a restore drill that checks a payment and its receipt arrive together.

cause: Save handlers return early at the free limit without clearing their busy state, so Save keeps spinning.
guard: Clear busy state in a finally block in the shared save helper.

cause: The forgotten-workout pause depends on the app being open and on timers that are only opened, so the workout keeps counting.
guard: Run the idle pause from the workout's own clock in the notification service, tested with the app closed.

cause: Sideways-scrolling rows hide items off the edge with no scroll bar, arrow or wrap.
guard: Shared chip and photo rows that wrap or show a scroll cue on non-touch and narrow screens.

cause: HQ's AI limit form sends whole defaults instead of what was changed, so a blank box becomes 0 and trial limits are overwritten.
guard: Send only changed fields, treat empty as empty, and test trial and blank cases.

cause: Deletes and repairs that touch several tables run as separate steps, so a close mid-way leaves data half gone.
guard: Wrap multi-table writes in one transaction, with a test that kills the write mid-way.

cause: Old paths (the ForgeAI app, the Drive restore) are retired by date without a plan for the people still on them.
guard: Retire an old path only after a move-off screen and a usage check, written in the release plan.

cause: Full-screen pop-ups (phone update, watch update, free month) decide on their own when to show, so one hides or blocks another for good.
guard: One shared pop-up queue that shows one at a time and keeps the rest waiting, tested with two due at once.

cause: What's new notes are written by hand with no check against the real behaviour or the app they ship in, so they can say the reverse of what happens or repeat the phone's notes for the watch.
guard: Tag each What's new line with its app and the feature it describes, and review it against that feature before upload.

cause: The friend-reward already-given check is keyed on the friend's name, not the enquiry.
guard: Key rewards on the enquiry id, with a test of two friends with the same name.

cause: An offline or not-yet-confirmed receipt is handled differently on each payment screen, so one shows no receipt number and another lets it be sent.
guard: One shared receipt-state helper (confirmed, waiting) used by every payment screen and the WhatsApp send.

cause: The watch keeps its own copy of set-entry rules (required weight, effort choices) instead of getting them from the phone.
guard: The phone sends the set rules to the watch, with a shared rule test both apps run.

cause: Screens offer or promise things that were never built (a WhatsApp send, a trainer-teaches view, a limit-raise tool), because words were written ahead of the feature with no check that it exists.
guard: A rule that a button or promise ships only with the feature behind it, checked in the fresh-eyes review against the live feature list.

cause: HQ writes the Log line before the change is checked and saved.
guard: Write the audit line only after a successful change.

cause: Only the top branch list checks for unsent entries before switching.
guard: Put the unsent check inside the single branch-switch function.

cause: Putting a gym online copies once and does not send entries saved during the copy.
guard: Send anything newer after the last copy round, with a test.

cause: The owner site offers in-person setup with no area limit.
guard: State the visit area on the site.

cause: The nightly door update runs inside the admin app instead of on the server.
guard: Run scheduled door updates on the server.

cause: The watch keeps the last heart rate when the sensor says off-wrist.
guard: Clear the reading on off-wrist or unavailable.

cause: The chart's opening range skips the free-plan check that later range changes run.
guard: Run the plan check in one place for every range set.

cause: Outage and key notes are posted in a public place.
guard: Post outage notes only in the private crashes store.

cause: The routine rest picker uses a fixed default instead of the saved one.
guard: Pass the saved default, with a test.

cause: The quick-buttons sheet lists rows in a fixed order, ignoring the chosen order.
guard: List chosen buttons in their order, with a test.

cause: The booking sheet opens on the shown week even when it is over.
guard: Default the sheet to today when the week is past.

cause: The weigh-in typo check compares against the weigh-in being replaced.
guard: Exclude the same day's entry, with a test.

cause: Un-pause sets a fixed status instead of restoring the gym's earlier one.
guard: Store and restore the prior status, with a test.

cause: A member paying the gym by UPI has no way to tell the gym.
guard: Add an I-have-paid step that alerts the desk.

cause: The welcome message to a new owner has no admin app address.
guard: Add the address from config to the template.

cause: Screen text is typed in each screen instead of one shared word list, so the same thing has two, three or four names across screens and apps.
guard: One shared glossary that screens pull their nouns from, and a words check that flags banned synonyms.

cause: Whole surfaces and screens (HQ, the phone app, the assistant, signed-out and newer panel pages) are left out of the automatic accessibility check.
guard: The accessibility crawl takes its page list from the router of every surface, so new pages are included automatically.

cause: House style rules (never 'OK', sentence case, plain true lines) are known but not enforced, so individual lines slip through clumsy or untrue.
guard: Run the words check (banned words, casing, plain-English review) over every user-facing string in CI.

cause: Pop-up sends assume success (the address is cleared, the summary claimed, the renewed address ignored) instead of confirming hand-over, so some pop-ups are lost.
guard: Mark a pop-up delivered only after the push service accepts it, and retry the rest; tested with a failed and a renewed address.

cause: Lines that promise a phone notification are written as always true, though delivery depends on the member's settings and the server path.
guard: A words-check rule that any promise of a pop-up uses the shared 'if notifications are on' phrasing.

cause: Calendar day cells read their raw date ('2026-11-03') to screen readers, because each calendar builds its own label instead of one spoken-date helper.
guard: One shared spoken-date label used by every calendar.

cause: The card draws its heading only once the member app is on.
guard: Draw the heading in every card state, with a picture test.

cause: The gym sync sign-in card has no forgotten-password path.
guard: Add a reset link before the card is switched on.

cause: The anti-robot box value is not passed on in one of the PIN reset paths.
guard: Pass the value on every send, with a test for each path.

cause: The coach mic works only while held, which a screen reader cannot do.
guard: Offer tap-to-start and tap-to-stop recording.

cause: Start-up recovery ignores a rest that ended seconds before.
guard: Treat a just-ended rest as over at start-up.

cause: Reply pop-ups put the message words on the lock screen.
guard: Leave private words out of pop-up bodies by rule in the send helper.
